question: In 1991, the government set up the Tax Reforms Committee under the chairmanship of:
solution:
The correct answer is **__Raja J Chelliah.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The government constituted the Tax Reforms Committee (TRC) in August 1991, under the chairmanship of **Professor Raja J.** **Chelliah** to recommend measures for the reform of Central taxes.
 
• This TRC came up with three reports in **1991, 1992 and 1993** with several measures, which can be summarized in these points.
 
 
• Reforming the personal taxation system by reducing the marginal tax rates.
 
• Reduction in the corporate tax rates.
 
• Reducing the cost of imported inputs
 
• Reforming the personal taxation system by reducing the marginal tax rates.
 
• by lowering the customs duties.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Raghuram Govindarajan** is an Indian economist and the Katherine Dusak Miller Distinguished Service Professor of Finance at the University of Chicago Booth School of Business.
 
• Between 2003 and 2006 he was **Chief Economist and director of research at the International Monetary Fund.**
 
• **Vijay L. Kelkar** is an Indian economist and academic, who is currently the Chairman of the Forum of Federations, Ottawa & India Development Foundation, New Delhi.
 
• **Pamulaparthi Venkata Narasimha Rao **was an Indian lawyer and politician who served as the 9th Prime Minister of India from **1991 to 1996.** He is often referred to as the **"Father of Indian Economic Reforms"**
